title: Rating Actions and Notch Change
user_story: As a rating analyst, I want to record rating actions so that every rating change is tracked with its notch movement.

acceptance_criteria.text: Supported action types are NEW, UPGRADE, DOWNGRADE, AFFIRM and WITHDRAW.

The action type must match the rating change: UPGRADE requires a higher new rating, DOWNGRADE a lower new rating, AFFIRM an unchanged rating. Otherwise the action is rejected with ACTION_TYPE_MISMATCH.

notch_change is the difference in ordinal positions on the agency's own scale: positive for an upgrade, negative for a downgrade, 0 for an affirmation (Moody's-style: Aaa=1 ... C=21; Fitch-style: AAA=1 ... C=21, RD=22, D=23).
The effective date may be today or in the past. A future effective date is rejected with FUTURE_EFFECTIVE_DATE.
NEW is allowed only when the issuer has no active rating from that agency; otherwise it is rejected with RATING_ALREADY_EXISTS. WITHDRAW sets the rating status to WR (MOODYS) or WD (FITCH).
Large downgrades must be highlighted for senior review.
